entry.title: [mostafamalekian] 🔴From "Taking Pride in Ferdowsi" to "Learning from Ferdowsi"✍Mostafa…
entry.summary:
Source: @mostafamalekian

🔴From "Taking Pride in Ferdowsi" to "Learning from Ferdowsi"✍Mostafa Malekian🔹Iran now has a population of 80 million. Do you think 1,000 out of these 80 million people have read the Shahnameh from beginning to end? They haven't. That is, out of our 80 million population, I firmly believe not even a thousand have read the Shahnameh from start to finish.🔹The expectation that we want 80 million people to read the Shahnameh is not realistic. So, your pride in Ferdowsi—what is it pride in? It's pride in someone whose words you don't know at all; someone whose poetry you can't even read a single page of. So what are you proud of? You're taking pride in something illusory.@mostafamalekian
